title: When the Gravity Burns Revisited
author: R. M. Thackeray
blurb: Sebastian Whitlock, a terraformer tending a garden meant for people not yet born, has spent fifteen years hauling cargo through contested orbits. But when an unfamiliar name shows up on the manifest of a ship that never flew, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now he must deliver a message that will end the war — or start it, and time is already running out.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
